# prompt-render

> Type-safe `{{variable}}` renderer for prompt files

prompt-render is a TypeScript library for rendering plain-text template files with
`{{token}}` substitution, schema validation at module load, and fail-closed
behaviour. Values are inserted verbatim. The package does not parse markdown.

See the Decisions section of README.md for the locked decisions: independent of
sql-render, file-first with a string seam, no frontmatter, public digest, no
untyped mode, round-trip byte safety, opt-in safety descriptors, and guards
over the template file.

## Install

```bash
npm install prompt-render
```

## API

### defineTemplate

```typescript
import { defineTemplate, text } from 'prompt-render';

const prompt = defineTemplate('./generation.md', {
  task: text.required,
  outputDir: text.absolutePath,
  resultSchema: text.block,
});

const { markdown, digest, bytes } = prompt({ task, outputDir, resultSchema });
prompt.digest; // sha256 hex of the raw file bytes
prompt.path;   // resolved absolute path
prompt.tokens; // unique names, first-appearance order
```

Schema keys must match template tokens at define time. Types are inferred via
`InferParams<S>`. There is no untyped generic mode.

The result's `digest` is sha256 hex of the rendered UTF-8 bytes and `bytes` is
their length; both are computed on first access.

An optional third argument takes `{ guards }`.

### defineStringTemplate

```typescript
import { defineStringTemplate, text } from 'prompt-render';

const greet = defineStringTemplate('Hello {{name}}\n', {
  name: text.required,
}, { label: 'greet.md' });
```

`label` is required, non-empty, and is what errors name. `digest` is sha256 of
the UTF-8 source bytes. Prefer `defineTemplate` when the text is an audit
artifact.

### Schema types

- `text.required` - non-empty string, no NUL, no unpaired surrogate
- `text.block` - same validate as `required`; name marks a large insert
- `text.line` - like `required`, rejects `\n` and `\r`
- `text.absolutePath` - like `required`, plus `path.isAbsolute` for the host

Opt-in refusals (defaults stay verbatim):

- `text.plain` - no control characters other than tab and newline, no bidi
  controls, no zero-width or invisible formatting, no Unicode tag characters
- `text.noFence` - no run of three or more backticks
- `text.maxBytes(n)` / `text.maxChars(n)` - size budget, UTF-8 bytes or UTF-16
  code units
- `text.fencedBlock({ lang })` - the only descriptor that adds bytes: frames
  the value in a fence one backtick longer than the longest run inside it. The
  value itself is untouched.

None of these is a prompt-injection defence.

### Descriptor tooling

A descriptor is `{ validate(value): boolean; format?(value): string }`.
`format` normalises or frames, never escapes. Optional `reason(value): string`
names a failure without echoing the value.

- `defineType<T>(descriptor)` - identity at runtime; keeps the parameter type,
  which a bare object literal would widen to `unknown`
- `allOf(...descriptors)` - every member validates the original value; the
  first failure supplies the reason; `format` steps run in argument order

### Template guards

```typescript
defineTemplate('./generation.md', schema, {
  guards: [guard.trailingNewline, guard.noPattern('no-vendor', /\bacme\b/i)],
});
```

A guard is `{ name, validate(source), reason? }`, runs at define time before
the placeholder scan, and validates the file without rewriting it. Failure is
`TEMPLATE_REJECTED`. `guard.noPattern` refuses `g` and `y` regex flags.

### Byte rules

- Placeholder: `{{name}}` where name is `[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*`
- `{{ name }}`, `{{}}`, `{{{name}}}`, unclosed `{{`: define-time error
- `{{__proto__}}` is reserved; other prototype member names are ordinary
- Single `{` / `}` are data
- `{{{{` emits literal `{{`. To write `{{task}}`, write `{{{{task}}`
- Files are UTF-8, LF only, no leading BOM
- Unpaired surrogates are refused in the source and in every rendered value
- Trailing newline preserved; values inserted verbatim; no rescan
- Duplicate tokens allowed

### Errors

All errors are `PromptRenderError` and name the template file. Placeholder errors
report `path:line:column` and carry `line` / `column`.

- `FILE_NOT_FOUND`, `FILE_UNREADABLE`, `INVALID_ENCODING`
- `CRLF_REFUSED`, `BOM_REFUSED`, `MALFORMED_PLACEHOLDER`, `RESERVED_PLACEHOLDER`
- `UNKNOWN_PLACEHOLDER`, `UNUSED_PARAMETER`, `INVALID_DESCRIPTOR`
- `INVALID_OPTIONS`, `INVALID_PARAMS`, `TEMPLATE_REJECTED`
- `INVALID_VALUE` (parameter + reason, never the value)

## Not this package

No conditionals, loops, partials, helpers, frontmatter, escaping, export I/O,
markdown parsing, or chat/model/tool binding. Two templates, not a branch.
